sampleRule: Sort supplemental records by buildingId and inspect records at floor(i * (N - 1) / 11) for i=0..11. Full source crops were viewed; ground crops remain source-bound companions and were not used to infer predictions.

aggregateObserved.interpretation: The inspected sample is strongly weighted toward historic brick row/canal-style facades and has limited clearly legible retail detail. It does include one curved bay, several arched heads, multiple dormers/gables, and two visible commercial fronts. The sample does not support claims about the full batch's typology or retail proportions.

coverageAssessment.representativeness: limited; deterministic spacing reduces selection discretion but does not make this sample statistically representative
biases: source inventory is geographically constrained to Da Costa/Jordaan-area cached geometry
historic brick frontages dominate the inspected sample
retail is underrepresented relative to the user's desired retail-detail coverage
trees, vehicles, crop boundaries, and narrow frontage intervals frequently hide thresholds or lower openings
roof silhouettes are visible in many cases but dormer details are small or absent in several flat-roof cases
coverageAssessment.developmentUse: Suitable as a source-coverage warning and for prioritizing retail, unobscured ground fronts, and roof-detail cases for later inspection; not a held-out certification or fidelity claim.
